# Company
> VenturesNodes is a premier startup consultancy based in Jaipur, Rajasthan, India. We help Indian founders, MSMEs, and entrepreneurs navigate complex government registrations, secure grants and funding, get incubated, and scale their businesses with expert precision.

## About
